verdict.rationale: Loops documents a dedicated POST /transactional endpoint for one-to-one sends with data variables and attachments. It explicitly positions transactional email (password resets, login codes, receipts) as sent from the same API and contact model as marketing and product email, with Bearer-token auth, typed SDKs, and an OpenAPI spec confirmed live by probe. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending, and attachments require enablement by Loops support.
